name: Duncan Engineering Limited
about: Duncan Engineering Limited manufactures, assembles, and trades in fluid power and automation products in India and internationally. The company offers ball, screwed end ball, knife gate, bulk solid handling, butterfly, and trunnion mounted ball, midget, diaphgram, pulse, modular, high flow, and poppet valves; rack and pinion pneumatic, and scotch and yoke pneumatic actuator; valve automation systems; and linear actuator. It also provides positioner cylinder, control panels, air motor cylinder, burner tilt power cylinder, secondary air damper control, and stand mount cylinder; valve accessories, high pressure valves and inflating connections, bore valve extensions, tubeless spuds, tubeless single bend swivel valves, and garage and in-plant service equipment, as well as limit switch box, quick exhaust valves, flow control valves, air lock relay valves, and volume boosters. The company's products are used in aerospace, food and beverage, oil & gas, power, automotive, cement, chemicals, HVAC, paint, industrial manufacturing, paper, mining, pharmaceutical, steel, textile, and water & wastewater industries. The company was formerly known as Schrader Duncan Limited and changed its name to Duncan Engineering Limited in December 2016. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Pune, India. Duncan Engineering Limited is a subsidiary of Oriental Carbon & Chemicals Limited.
